Start/control API with Idempotency-Key replay/conflict, owner-only and bot-scoped access (401, cross-bot 404), private-input barrier
Encrypted persistence (info_encrypted, MinIO chunks without raw keysyms, draft_encrypted), duplicate poll idempotence, interrupted recovery, discard and maintain GC
Evidence review freeze (422 unknown frame, evidence_hash, generate after freeze 409), draft validation, vision-checked generation, cancel-generation
